minor.issue: last_sweep returned null even though db.rent_sweeps has the prior sweep {closed:72, reclaimed_sol:0.108996, rows:72}. Root cause: RentReclaimer.last_sweep is in-memory only (rent_reclaim.py:34) and uvicorn --reload wipes it. The DB record exists but the endpoint does not hydrate from it. Mitigation: on first /wallet/rent call (or in RentReclaimer __init__), load the most recent rent_sweeps doc into self.last_sweep (projection: {at,closed,reclaimed_sol,sigs,errors}, exclude _id). Non-blocking because reclaimable_sol/accounts are still live-scanned, but the UI will show no history after any backend restart.

action_items: Fix last_sweep hydration: have RentReclaimer load the most-recent /rent_sweeps document from Mongo at startup (or lazily on first scan) so GET /api/wallet/rent shows prior sweeps after backend reload. Projection should drop _id.
critical_code_review_comments: rent_reclaim.py keeps last_sweep purely in-memory; combined with uvicorn --reload (which runs during normal dev) this makes the UI chip's 'last sweep' invisible for the common case. Easiest fix: at RentReclaimer.start(), do `doc = await self.state.db.rent_sweeps.find_one(sort=[('at',-1)], projection={'_id':0}); self.last_sweep = doc`.

server.py /api/wallet/import success response returns {ok, public_key, unchanged} when key matches, but the error path raises HTTPException with the raw parse_secret message (e.g. 'expected 64-byte secret (or 32-byte seed), got 6 bytes'). Prefix is still 'could not parse key:' so the frontend contract holds — just noting that any future wording change in parse_secret ripples through the UI toast with no translation layer.
ImportWallet.jsx textarea autofocuses the real secret into the DOM; consider type='password' or masking on blur so screen-recorded sessions don't leak the key paste.

rca of the issue: Reported bug: GET /api/wallet/rent returned last_sweep=null though the earlier manual sweep (closed=72, reclaimed_sol≈0.109) succeeded. Repro: curl /api/wallet/rent after backend restart → last_sweep:null; mongosh db.rent_sweeps.find() → doc present. Cause: rent_reclaim.py:34 initialises self.last_sweep=None and only ever writes it in-memory inside sweep(); uvicorn --reload rebuilds the process and the attribute is reset. The DB insert at line 129 is correct, but server.py:1643 reads bot_state.rent.last_sweep without any DB fallback. Fix: on RentReclaimer.start() (or in __init__ after db attach), await self.state.db.rent_sweeps.find_one(sort=[('at',-1)], projection={'_id':0}) and assign to self.last_sweep.
